facts.text: The image is a character reference sheet arranged as a large hero panel at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle row, and four close-up detail panels along the bottom.

The hero panel shows a single adult person standing on a wet rooftop or industrial walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides, rain streaks, reflective ground, dark buildings, and blurred city lights.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, and wears a black high-collared tactical-style jacket, a black top, black pants, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the hero panel, the person stands with the body facing forward and the head turned toward the left side of the frame.
The FRONT panel shows the same person standing upright, facing the camera with arms at the sides.
The SIDE PROFILE panel shows the person standing in profile, facing toward the left side of the frame.
The BACK panel shows the person from behind, standing with arms at the sides, revealing the jacket back, pants, and boots.
The FACE close-up shows the person facing the camera with a neutral expression; a small mark is visible above one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR close-up shows a high black collar with strap and metal buckle/hardware details.
The HANDS close-up shows the person’s hands with relaxed fingers and visible skin texture.
The BOOTS close-up shows black lace-up combat boots with worn-looking leather and dark laces.
Legible labels on the sheet are HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

card.summary: A dark, photorealistic character reference sheet for one adult person with an undercut and small topknot, dressed in a black tactical jacket, black pants, and combat boots; it includes a rainy rooftop hero shot, front/side/back turnaround views, and face, collar, hands, and boots detail panels.
